# vcraft 1.4.4

A patch release: the macOS wheel is self-contained again.

## Fixed

- **The macOS wheel is self-contained.** The `vcraft` binary linked Boehm's
  `libgc.dylib` dynamically and V baked the build machine's path as an rpath
  (`/private/tmp/v-src/thirdparty/tcc/lib`), which only existed on the machine that built
  it. Installing the wheel anywhere else failed with
  `dyld: Library not loaded: @rpath/libgc.dylib`. The wheel now carries `libgc.dylib` next
  to the binary, the dependency is rewritten to `@loader_path/libgc.dylib`, the
  build-machine rpath is dropped and the binary is re-signed, so it runs wherever it is
  installed. It worked before only by the accident of a matching temp directory.
- The tool wheel suite now builds a project **through the installed wheel** (the path the
  published action takes), not only through `bin/vcraft`, so a Windows-only launcher
  failure is caught by CI.

## Upgrade

```console
$ pip install --upgrade vcraft
```

Full list in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rroblf01/vcraft/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#144---2026-10-16).
